title.narrative: Bihar State Highways Project (formerly Bihar State Roads Investment Program)

description.narrative: The proposed investment program will improve transport efficiency of the state road network, which will contribute to expansion of economic opportunities and poverty reduction. This will be realized by improving the state road network and enhancing State Government of Bihar's (GOB) capacity for road asset development and management.

title.narrative: Loan 2443: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022
Progress Toward Outcome: Overall physical progress is 59.6% as of 31 May 2011.
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Aug 2008: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41127-03-ind-rp.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2015: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41127-013-smr-02.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Overall physical progress is 59.5% based on the May 2011 monthly progress reports.
Packages 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9 are performing well and are expected to be completed as scheduled. Packages 1, 2, 3 and 7 are experiencing some delays and packages 1 and 2 may require extension beyond the loan closing date.
TA 7130: 76% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022
